meta.title: Fulus – Group Investing Platform
meta.description: Fulus is an all-in-one mobile platform for group investing where people pool money, collaborate together, and invest under one web3 decentralized wallet.
hero.subhead: Fulus is an all-in-one mobile platform for group investing where people pool money, collaborate together, and invest under one web3 decentralized wallet.

benefits.title: Everything you need to automate, optimize, and scale
benefits.cards.0.title: Access to Exclusive Investments
benefits.cards.0.body: Invest in assets that are typically out of reach for individual investors.
benefits.cards.1.title: Reduced Risk
benefits.cards.1.body: Invest in a wider range of assets to diversify risk.
benefits.cards.2.title: Knowledge Sharing
benefits.cards.2.body: Leverage collective knowledge and resources to achieve better returns.
services.title: Smarter Services, Built for Investment Clubs
services.subhead: Everything you need to simplify management, grow together, and stay in control.
services.cards.0.title: Launch Your Club with Ease
services.cards.0.body: Set up a new club in minutes — invite members, define rules, and start investing together.
services.cards.1.title: Manage Shared Funds
services.cards.1.body: Distribute profit, transfer funds, handle redemption and subscription — all from one dashboard.
services.cards.2.title: Track Portfolios in Real Time
services.cards.2.body: Live tickers and valuations across your club's holdings — equities, crypto, and tokenized assets.
services.cards.3.title: Automate Profit Distribution
services.cards.3.body: Pro-rata calculations across all members, every cycle — accurate, automatic, auditable.
services.cards.4.title: Generate Clear Reports Instantly
services.cards.4.body: Member-level statements, club-wide P&L, transaction histories — exportable on demand.
features.title: All features in one place
features.subhead: Everything your club needs to manage, invest, and grow together with confidence.
process.title: Our Simple & Smart Process
process.subhead: Everything you need to create, invest, and grow together.
process.cards.0.title: Create or Join a Club
process.cards.0.body: Start your investment journey by forming a new club or joining an existing one with ease.
process.cards.1.title: Contribute & Collaborate
process.cards.1.body: Pool funds with members, propose investments, and decide together with transparent records.
process.cards.2.title: Invest, Track, Distribute
process.cards.2.body: Buy and hold across asset classes; the platform handles ownership math and profit distribution.
